 Order

By virtue of the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (BNSS) [erstwhile Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C.)], the applicants seek quashing of FIR No.364/2022 registered at PS.: Rani Bagh, Delhi under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and all proceedings emanating therefrom.

2. Learned counsel for the parties seek, and are granted, a period of four days for filing a joint affidavit regarding the higher education of the minor daughter, Ms. Tvesha Arora, which shall be read in addition to the terms of settlement.
